content: Sinaí-yargi-Israel-dulemar-ebislesad
Israel-dulemar birgabogus gaka nii-warbo-ibagwengusa Egipto-yargi-bukwa ainisgusmaladgine, Bab-Jehová Sinaí-nega-dulesulidganba, dulemarbo-ambikued-neggi, Moisésʼga sunmaksad. Weyob ega sogded:
“Bela Israel-dulemar be ebiso, na e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba be ebiso. Bela machergan-irba e-nug be meso.
Bee be, be-ia-Aarónʼbo, dulemar-ilekwaa na e-sordamar-bukwadba machergan birga-durgwen (20) nikamalad, degi, birga-durgwen-obine (20+) nikamalad, sunna dule-bila-onogedse-namalad be ebiso.
Bemar-bendakega bemar-dadgan-warambe-gakabogwad-war-wargwengi, neguyagi-dummadga-gudiid be suoed.”
Nug-weega-nugsalesmalad
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “We-dulemala, bemar-bendakmaloedid:
Dule-nug-welesmalad-ebislesad
Degisoggu, Moisés, degi, Aarón, we-dulemar-nugsalesmaladse e-nugba ese gochasunnad.

Nii-warbogwad gebe-iba-onodedgi, Moisés bela dulemar-danar urbisad. Geb degine, machergan na e-dadgan-e-dadganba, na e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba bela e-nugmar mesisad. Bela machergan birga-dulagwen-nikad (20), degine, birga-dulagwen-obine-nikamaladi (20+), e-nugmar narmaklesad.
Ar Bab-Jehová igi Moisésʼga-sogsagusa, deyob, Moisés Sinaí-nega-dulesulidganba dulemar-ebichisad.

content: Leví-wagan-nugsalesmalad
Leví-wagandi, na e-gwenadgan-e-gwenadganba, amardi Israel-dulemar-baiganba ebislessurmalad.
Ar ade, Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogsagusad:
“Unnila Leví-waganbi Israel-dulemar-abargi be ebisosulid.

Be, Levita-dulemar Dulemar-Anbo-Igar-Mesisad-E-Neg-dakega be imakoed. Degine, a-neggi-ibmar-ebulemalad, degi, bela a-negga-ibmar-ebulemalad-dakega, be imakbaloed. Levita-dulemala, anse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged, degine, bela e-ibmarmar-agi-ebulemalad semaloed. Degine, Levita-dulemarbi agi arbamaloed. Degine, a-neg-dikar-ebilis megmaloed. A-ular, Leví-e-wagan be ebisosulid.”

Bab-Dummad Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Anse-goled-neg-sunna-seleged seledsokalile, Levita-dulemar a-neg earoed. A-neg gannar osisokarmalale, Levita-dulemar osimarbaloed. Dule-baid, Levita-dulesulid a-negse warmaksale, oburgwilegoed.
Israel-dulemar na danar-danar, degine, na e-bander-e-bander-urba ambikumaloed. E-sordamar-bila-onomalad-ilemakar ega soglesadba ambikumaloed.
Levita-dulemardi, Dulemar-Anbo-Igar-Mesisad-E-Neg-dikar-ebilis ambikumaloed, adi, melle an-urwed Israel-dulemargi yolegegar. Levitaʼmar, Dulemar-Anbo-Igar-Mesisad-E-Neg edarboed.”
Israel-dulemala bela Bab-Jehová-Moisésʼga-ibmar-sogsadba imaksamalad. Ar deyob bela imaksamardo.
